note: The plan says straight on her face in the button, so only the MG9 top overlay sits there and nothing covers her last line or the hold.

mg.title: Are you happy?
mg.src: The Are You Happy? question from this blueprint (row 00:05–00:07).
mg.use: This is the planned question top text at 00:05. Use it as that text, not as a second one. Then cut to her answer.

mg.title: Over the moon

text.main: I would even say over the moon.

mg.use: Top band, over her big smile as she says it. The name super stays lower left. Keep captions on.

mg.title: No words for it

text.main: there's almost no words for it.

mg.use: Short full-frame cutaway on the end of her answer, then back to her face.

mg.title: 4EveryKid tag
mg.src: Kara McGlynn, 030_3155.MXF [00:41] “the For Every Kid event” (blueprint spelling: 4EveryKid)
mg.use: Small tag when she says For Every Kid. Spell it 4EveryKid.

mg.title: Smiling faces

text.main: Seeing their smiling faces fills my heart.

mg.use: Only if you add this line to the cut, right after the WHY row. Full-frame.

mg.title: Frame her listening
mg.use: Brackets around her face while she listens, under the question text. Move them to where her face sits.

mg.title: Brand new shoes

text.main: a brand new name brand pair of shoes

mg.use: Over her as she says it. Keep captions on.

mg.title: We do care

text.main: remind our students that we do care and that there are people who want to help

mg.use: Last part of the row, as she says it. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Stop and notice
mg.src: Kara McGlynn, 030_3155.MXF [01:25] “when we stop and slow down and take the time to notice”
mg.use: Each word lands on her voice, in the top band. Gone before her last line and the hold.
